facts.fact: The BCEAO operates PI-SPI, the interoperable instant payment platform now connecting banks, microfinance institutions, e-money issuers and payment institutions across the eight UEMOA countries, 24/7.
PI-SPI is a single regional instant payment infrastructure run by the BCEAO for the eight UEMOA countries.

systems.tiers: banks, microfinance, e-money issuers, payment institutions
